quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the importance of winning and leaving his comfort zone
quotes.excerpt: All that matters is winning. In order for me to go to the next level, I got to get out of my comfort zone.
quotes.quote: All that matters is winning. In order for me to go to the next level, I got to get out of my comfort zone, and I feel like Miami was a place for me to be. But you got to work.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo and Caron Butler discuss the need for higher performance standards
quotes.excerpt: It's not good enough. Making 10 in a minute. Not good enough. Again.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: It's not good enough. Making 10 in a minute. Not good enough. Again. You know, and then when I promise you it's going to be December 12th playing against Charlotte, that shot is going to go in.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: You know, once we're in the season and things are going the way they're supposed to, you get in a place that you are okay. But until that happens, anything anybody tells me, my spider sense is up. My alertness is from training camp, from kick-off, from new organization, new people watching me. Until I'm in game 40, and I'm busting their ass for 40 games, and I'm healthy and things are going well, I'm not saying I'm going to relax. I'm saying I'll be like, okay. I'm still him. I'm still that guy. But until then, my spider sense is always up. Every game is a fight.
